label: Futures Cone
description: Maps plausible, possible and preferable futures from a present condition, making uncertainty, assumptions and decision boundaries explicit before a direction is chosen.

zh.label: 未来锥
zh.description: 从当前条件展开可能、可行与理想的未来范围，在选择方向前明确不确定性、默认假设与决策边界。

theory_mapping.source_notes: Use the cone to distinguish ranges of futures, not to predict a single outcome.

model_constraints: Separate plausible, possible and preferable futures; do not present them as forecasts.
State which assumptions widen or narrow each range.
Keep the preferable future tied to stakeholders and an explicit value choice.

recommendation.best_when: A team needs to compare the range of futures before selecting one scenario to develop.

presentation.interaction_hint: Compare ranges before committing to one branch.
